messages:
maya: idea: add a tiny 'anchor' marker from the scrubber so you can snap to event windows and compare p95 across days without reselecting ranges.

leo: nice. how do we create it? long-press on the scrubber or a + button? keyboard accessible?

maya: propose ALT+click on scrubber or a visible + when hovering a range. keyboard: focus scrubber, press Enter to create anchor. anchors session-scoped by default.

sam: sampling caveat: our current bucketed reservoir sampling can change p95 when you shift windows. suggest "Sampled" badge on the latency card with hover showing sample_rate and sampling_strategy. add API fields sampling_rate and sampling_strategy.

tia: accessibility: anchor creation must announce via aria-live: "Anchor created: <label>" and be reachable by keyboard. marker needs strong contrast against heatmap; ensure focus order: scrubber -> anchor list -> chart.

aria: microcopy proposals: action "Add anchor"; tooltip "Snap a marker to this time for quick comparison." badge text: "Sampled view"; tooltip: "Uses sampled data (%s). Click to run full scan."

joss: perf: prefer streaming deltas when switching anchors (anchor_mode=stream) to avoid full re-queries. full-mode behind a confirm modal with cost estimate.

maya: next steps: aria + color pass (tia/aria) and eng to confirm API names (sam) by EOD. i'll post a tiny figma frame and book a 15m review.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:)
